papers_read.title_as_printed: Statistical Method for Identification of Alzheimer Disease With Multimodal Predictive Markers Mild Cognitive Impairment (Zarei, Shalbaf & Shalbaf, Basic and Clinical Neuroscience 2025, 16(SI):233-250)

Explainable Machine Learning with Pairwise Interactions for Predicting Conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Utilizing Multi-Modalities Data (Cai et al., Brain Sci. 2023, 13, 1535)

what_each_reports.P-334: ADNI-MERGE, 835 MCI participants (487 sMCI, 348 pMCI), visit records labelled (pMCI records only within 3 years before conversion). Univariate AUC per single feature, no model, no validation: florbetaben PET AUC 0.84 (highest), ADAS13/mPACCtrailsB 0.83, hippocampus 0.75.
what_each_reports.P-211: ADNI, 1042 amnestic MCI patients at baseline. Explainable Boosting Machine with pairwise interactions on baseline MRI volumes/thickness + ADAS13/MMSE/FAQ/CDR-SB + age, sex, education, baseline diagnosis, APOE4; 90/10 split, SMOTE, 5-fold CV, separate models for conversion within 1-5 years: 5-year accuracy 85%, AUC 0.92; AUC about 0.9 at 1 year, lowest at 3 years (test-set 0.81 with interactions).

quantity_a: Univariate record-level ROC-AUC of a single amyloid-PET measure (florbetaben) separating sMCI records from pMCI records within 3 years before conversion; no model, no validation
quantity_b: Cross-validated participant-level ROC-AUC of a multivariable EBM (baseline structural MRI + cognitive scores + demographics + APOE4, no PET) for conversion from aMCI to AD within 5 years
incompatible_if_same: No: a single biomarker's univariate AUC (0.84) being lower than a multivariable model's AUC (0.92) is expected and not a contradiction; neither paper claims an ordering the other refutes. P-211's 3-year model (test AUC 0.81) is close to P-334's best univariate values.

gates.task: match in type (MCI-to-AD progression, T2) but horizons differ: records within 3 years of conversion vs conversion within 5 years (the contested 0.92)
gates.dataset_family: match: both ADNI; participant overlap probable
gates.validation_tier: mismatch: P-334 fits and validates no model; P-211 uses hold-out + 5-fold CV
gates.modality_family: mismatch: P-334's 0.84 is amyloid PET; P-211 uses structural MRI + cognition + APOE4, no PET; the record has modality_family_equal 'No'

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: both ROC-AUC, but single-marker univariate record-level discrimination vs multivariable participant-level prediction at a different horizon
independence: Distinct author groups; both use ADNI, so participant overlap is probable (recorded as non-independence)
grounds: P-334's 0.84 is the univariate AUC of one florbetaben PET measure with no fitted model, while P-211's 0.92 is a cross-validated multivariable EBM on MRI, cognitive and clinical features, so the predictor sets and modalities differ.
P-211's 0.92 refers to conversion within 5 years, whereas P-334's labels cover records up to 3 years before conversion, so the horizons differ.
The modality and validation-tier gates fail with no waiver on record.

evidence_quotes.quote: Our findings showed the strong predictive potential of PET, particularly florbetaben (FBB), which achieved an AUC of 0.84.
Only records preceding the AD diagnosis and those within the 3-year window before the conversion event receive labels.
The five-years prediction accuracy reached 85% (AUC = 0.92) using both cognitive scores and MRI markers.
Comb. (a) both MRI-driven biomarkers and cognitive test scores, plus age, gender, education, diagnose at baseline, and APOE4.
The main performance indicators, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and AUC, were 0.75, 0.78, 0.73, and 0.81 (with interaction effects)

record_defects: P-211 registry Sample_N_Approx '242804' is wrong; the paper includes 1042 aMCI patients.
P-334 registry Sample_N_Approx '487' is the sMCI group only; the analysed total is 835.
validation_comparable 'Yes' is wrong: P-334 fits no model.
resolution_note says 'Confirmed genuine' while resolution says 'Rejected: Task, dataset, or modality mismatch'; the fields contradict each other.
what_would_change_the_verdict: P-334 reporting a validated multivariable MRI + cognition model at a matching horizon whose AUC excluded P-211's, or P-211 reporting a PET-only model.
